therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: hepatocellular carcinoma patients scheduled for surgery
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: CT perfusion parameters (blood volume, blood flow, permeability surface) according to lesion differentiation

results.effect_size: Blood volume: well differentiated 15.930 vs moderately/poorly differentiated 13.958 mL/100g; Blood flow: 73.042 vs 72.051 mL/100g/min; Permeability surface: 26.421 vs 27.750 mL/100g/min
results.target_engagement_evidence: CT perfusion parameters successfully measured across lesion types
biomarker_changes: Portal venous perfusion lower in moderately/poorly differentiated lesions (13.708 vs 19.492 mL/min/100mL)
Hepatic perfusion index higher in moderately/poorly differentiated lesions (80.834% vs 75.232%)
Glutamine synthetase expression correlated with perfusion parameters
CD31 microvessel density correlated with perfusion parameters
subgroup_findings: Well differentiated lesions showed higher blood volume and portal venous perfusion
Glutamine synthetase expression levels showed variable correlation with perfusion parameters
CD31 expression levels showed variable correlation with perfusion parameters

context.duration: within a week from CT perfusion to surgery
